# collapse_ints

collapse_ints(nums) sorts the distinct integers in nums and joins them with commas, writing every run of 4 OR MORE consecutive integers as first-last. Inside a range, a negative endpoint is written in parentheses; outside a range, numbers are written plainly. collapse_ints([]) == "".

Examples:

- `collapse_ints([13, -8, 0]) == '-8,0,13'`
- `collapse_ints([-5, 14, 8, -1, -8, -7, 11, -3, 5]) == '-8,-7,-5,-3,-1,5,8,11,14'`
